Booking a Calendly call reserves time to talk; it is not an accepted quote, project booking or commitment to payment. Before work begins, both parties should agree in writing on scope, deliverables, schedule, fees, payment milestones, revisions, cancellation, confidentiality, licensing and usage rights.

Only share materials you are entitled to provide. Do not place passwords, payment information or confidential credentials in the calendar booking. Vorellia does not promise a particular number of views, leads, sales or return on advertising spend; outcomes depend on the offer, audience, media spend, distribution and market conditions.

Website information may change and access may occasionally be interrupted. Netlify, Calendly and Instagram are independent services with their own terms. These terms are intended to be interpreted under the laws applicable in Ontario, Canada, except where mandatory consumer or privacy law says otherwise.
